acquirer.name: The Gabelli Global Small and Mid Cap Value Trust

announcement.quote: The Fund is seeking additional shareholder participation in order to approve the contribution of a portion of the Fund’s assets to a newly formed, diversified, closed-end investment company, The Gabelli Global Small and Mid Cap Value Trust.

deals.notes: Not a merger of two existing funds: the 425 describes a contribution of a portion of the Gabelli Dividend & Income Trust's assets to a newly formed closed-end fund. The episode fund is the contributor, neither absorbed nor the issuer, hence role other. No tickers or exchange listing are printed in any excerpt. The later filings (DEF 14A and DEFA14A of 2014-04-02 and 2015-03-31) shown are annual-meeting materials whose excerpts do not mention this transaction, so how it ended is not stated.

problems: Focus asked how it ended, both tickers and listing: none of the five excerpted filings states the outcome, the tickers or the exchange listing of either fund.
